title: Airbnb Damage Deposit
scenario: A host asks for a security deposit outside the platform after check-in.

answers.A: Keep any deposit request inside the booking platform.
answers.B: Pay the extra deposit directly to avoid conflict with the host.
answers.C: Contact platform support and document the request.
answers.D: Agree in writing and pay if the host sends an invoice.

explanation: Moving a deposit outside the platform removes protection and makes the claim difficult to challenge. Use platform support.
proTip: A new payment request after check-in deserves a pause.
